mapper.select: SELECT mortgage_amount AS mortgageAmount, has_seizure AS hasSeizure, has_trust_registration AS hasTrustRegistration, owner_name AS ownerName, owner_type AS ownerType, land_owner_name AS landOwnerName, has_post_trust_infringement AS hasPostTrustInfringement FROM test_registry_data WHERE road_address = #{roadAddress}
SELECT is_illegal_building AS isIllegalBuilding, building_use AS buildingUse, building_type AS buildingType FROM test_building_data WHERE road_address = #{roadAddress}
SELECT recent_sale_price AS recentSalePrice, official_price AS officialPrice FROM test_price_data WHERE road_address = #{roadAddress}
